editorial.description_en: Cedar in winter, which does not lose its needles and does lose most of its light.
editorial.description_ja: 冬の杉のような、深く暗い緑。

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.330, C 0.056, h 154.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 冬 (fuyu, winter) + 杉 (sugi, cedar). It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "Winter Cedar" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 冬杉. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — kuro-midori at ΔE00 6.5, tetsu-midori at ΔE00 7.0, numa-kage at ΔE00 7.6. complementary is empty because no entry in this corpus sits within 22° of the opposite hue. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
